name.value: Cache Creek Desert Hills Taco Stand

description.value: The Cache Creek Desert Hills Taco Stand is a Mexican food counter operated by Desert Hills Ranch, a family-owned farm and market business rooted in the Thompson region since 1983. Situated on Hwy 97 (the Cariboo Highway) in Cache Creek, it makes a natural pit stop for cyclists riding one of BC's most iconic touring routes through the semi-arid interior. The parent operation is best known for its Ashcroft farm market growing tomatoes, potatoes, and fresh produce in the region's fertile volcanic soil, lending a local agricultural character to the broader Desert Hills brand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at deserthillsranch.com confirms the Cache Creek Taco Stand is an active, secondary location of Desert Hills Ranch (a family-owned farm business since 1983), situated at 2520 Hwy 97 in Cache Creek, BC — consistent with the OSM address and phone number (1.778.257.1433 matches OSM +1-778-257-1433). The website's contact page gives the Cache Creek physical address as '2520, Hwy 97, Cache Creek, BC', which aligns with OSM's '2520 Cariboo Highway' (Hwy 97 is the Cariboo Highway). No amenity details for bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, or similar are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all such fields default to null; the name 'taco stand' in the OSM record and the website's own reference to 'CACHE CREEK TACO STAND' are consistent, confirming this is a counter/stand-style food operation.
concerns: OSM lists the street as 'Cariboo Highway' while the website contact page uses 'Hwy 97, Cache Creek, BC' — these refer to the same road but the OSM address omits the city; no material discrepancy.
OSM opening_hours tag (Mo-Su 09:00-23:00) does not match the website, which states 9am-9pm daily except Wednesdays 9am-7pm — OSM hours appear to be inaccurate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating taco stand on a major BC cycling highway confirmed by an active website; straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink stop.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website is primarily for the Ashcroft farm market; the Cache Creek Taco Stand is a secondary location. The email deserthillsfarmmarket@gmail.com is listed on the website but absent from the OSM record — could be added.
